remarks: Discover your dream urban retreat at The Biltmore in the heart of downtown Stamford. A stunning one-bedroom corner unit located on the 10th floor. This beautifully designed residence boasts breathtaking panoramic views of the city skyline, providing a perfect backdrop for both relaxation and entertainment.  Inside, you'll find a spacious bedroom featuring a walk in closet, a modern kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances, and an inviting living area. Whether you're enjoying a quiet evening at home or hosting friends, this condo offers the ideal setting.  As a resident of The Biltmore, you'll enjoy access to a range of exceptional amenities, including a state-of-the-art fitness center, a convenient laundry room, and a chic lounge area perfect for socializing. The full-service front desk is available to assist with your needs around the clock.  With a prime location just steps away from trendy shops, diverse dining options, and the Metro North station, The Biltmore offers the perfect blend of luxury and convenience. Experience the vibrant lifestyle of downtown Stamford from your new home!
